title: Make results and day setup reachable and prominent
objective: Implement the highest-priority UI usability fixes: make the results/SOW side and day setup panels reachable from the primary cockpit hierarchy, give day setup clear prominence instead of a low-priority chip, and ensure open/close/focus behavior is understandable and accessible. Preserve existing backend/data contracts and finish-first reliability behavior.
design_authority: FEEDBACK-07-ui-direction.json (A06 Results/SOW reachability, A07 Day Setup prominence)
acceptance_criteria_met: Results/SOW panel has a clear primary entry point and is reachable from the main cockpit without hidden or dead controls.
Day setup has a prominent entry point with clear pending/setup state and accessible label.
Panel open/close/focus behavior works with mouse and keyboard and does not trap users.
Existing frontend tests plus focused panel tests pass.
No live POST calls, external writes, runtime restart, or dependency upgrades.
No calendar event mutation; no backend contract changes.

changes.behavior: Persistent 'Results' button in review/preview/verified dock states; opens the approval drawer (the SOW surface). Preview state labels it primary; review shows sub-label 'Preview writes'; verified shows sub-label 'statement of work'. Replaces the old 'Open approval'/'View result' labels. Day setup button gains a 'setup not confirmed' sub-label while state==setup.

h2 relabels per FEEDBACK-07: committed -> 'Results', armed -> 'Approve writes', review/preview -> 'Preview writes', loading unchanged. No-shadow review state renders guidance 'Run Preview commit from the dock to build the exact-writes preview.' so the reachable-but-not-built panel is never empty.

Pending setup chip upgraded from passive status note to prominent action: accent-tinted chip--setup-pending styling, visible text 'Setup pending — start here', aria-label 'Open day setup — setup not confirmed'. Confirmed state keeps calm 'Setup ✓' with aria-label 'Open day setup'.
Added .chip--setup-pending: accent-subtle background, accent-text color, accent border, weight 600 — outranks passive status chips in both themes.

Created: 11 focused tests covering Results reachability (review/preview/verified, absent in sequence/setup, T21 partial shout preserved), Day Setup prominence (pending chip + dock hint, confirmed collapse), and open/close/focus (keyboard-activated open, Escape close + focus restore, backdrop mouse close).

preserved_contracts: FEEDBACK-01..06 behavior unchanged (chronological sort, walls, infeasibility warnings, quarantine copy, scenario parity, zero calendar writer calls).
Two-gate live commit stays inside the approval drawer; dock still never renders a live-commit control.
T21 partial-commit shout preserved verbatim: 'Commit incomplete — view failures' with verification-failure count (failure-states.test.tsx green).
Existing dock labels pinned by tests unchanged: 'Confirm day setup', 'Preview commit', 'Auto sequence N blk', status texts.
useDialog focus management (initial focus, Tab wrap, Escape, focus restore) untouched; no dialog trap introduced.
No backend contract, store, adapter, or model changes; no dependency upgrades.

verification.npm test: 36 test files passed, 540 tests passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped
verification.live_contact: none — fixture harness only; no POST, no external writes, no restart, no launchctl

safety_proof.source_edits: 4 frontend source files + 1 test file + 1 evidence file
safety_proof.branch_or_index_mutation: none - no commit, stage, reset, clean, stash, rebase, or merge
